title: Small exact-context semantic patches after mechanical rewrites
failure_signature: A multi-region patch was rejected because one context line had already changed during the mechanical scaffold rewrite.
candidate_workaround: Read the current UTF-8 source and apply independent semantic regions with exact present context, then compile and inspect stale markers.
recurrence_guard: Never assume predecessor context survives a version rewrite; keep semantic patch regions small and verify the resulting file before promotion.
rollback: An atomic rejection changes no file; retain the negative and retry only after exact source inspection.
scope_boundary: Patch transport and semantic targeting only; successful application still requires tests and content review.
